description: We’re three Howard students spanning hardware, AI, and full-stack dev. Pierre (CS, ex-Abbott AI intern) builds polished React/Python apps. Kroix (EE) brings FPGA, C++, and chip design skills plus a 120K-player game. Brian (CS) founded ASTAR, an AI talent platform, and has AI and robotics experience. We ship real products fast. Looking for: data science or Earth/space science (NASA data), UI/UX design, and a strong presenter for our pitch.
